findings.obs_text: In Num 36:6, 2Sa 10:3, 1Ch 19:3, Jer 40:4 and Jer 40:5 think carries H5869I, the eye, or H0413 with it, in the idiom of what is good in someone's eyes: the think is a person's own judgment of what is best or fitting.
findings.grounds: Let them marry whom they think best

findings.obs_text: In 2Ki 18:20, Isa 36:5, 2Ch 13:8 and Eze 11:5 think carries H0559, to say, in its sense of saying in one's heart: the thought is a view put into words, and in Eze 11:5 the Lord states what the house of Israel thinks.
findings.grounds: So you think, O house of Israel

findings.obs_text: Think carries the Hebrew and Aramaic verbs of reckoning and devising: H2803J in Job 6:26, Job 35:2, Job 41:32, Psa 119:59, Psa 144:3 and Jer 23:27, H2803I in Isa 10:7, H1819 in Est 4:13 and H5452 in Dan 7:25. In some the thought is a judgment held, in others a plan pursued.
findings.grounds: When I think on my ways

findings.obs_text: In 2Sa 18:27 think carries H7200H, to see or consider: the watchman judges from what he sees. In Psa 119:52 it carries H2142, to remember: thinking of the rules from of old is calling them to mind.
findings.grounds: When I think of your rules from of old

findings.obs_text: Think carries G1380, to think or consider, in most of the Gospel verses and in 1Cor 4:9, 1Cor 7:40, 1Cor 12:23, 2Cor 11:16 and Heb 10:29: a view held about what is so, often asked of the hearer (Mat 17:25, Mat 22:42, Luk 10:36) or corrected (Mat 26:53, Luk 12:51, Luk 13:2, Joh 5:45).
findings.grounds: What do you think about the Christ

findings.obs_text: Think carries G3543, to suppose or deem, in Mat 5:17, Mat 10:34, Act 17:29 and 1Cor 7:26: in the first three the view is forbidden (do not think, we ought not to think), in 1Cor 7:26 Paul gives his own judgment.
findings.grounds: Do not think that I have come

findings.obs_text: Think carries G1760, to reflect, in Mat 9:4, G3539, to understand or perceive, in Eph 3:20, and G3049, to count or consider, in 2Cor 12:6 and Phili 4:8: the mind turned to a matter, evil in the heart in Mat 9:4 and what is excellent in Phili 4:8.
findings.grounds: Why do you think evil in your hearts

findings.obs_text: In Rom 12:3 and Phili 3:15 think carries G5426, to be minded, twice in each verse: a set of mind, sober rating of oneself, maturity. In 2Pe 1:13 it carries G2233, to consider, with G1161, a connective.
findings.grounds: not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think
